div.head: Ger 8

ab.seg: [8[a]] Æfre he mæig findan, on ðam he mæig nyt beon ⁊ ða nytte don, ðe him fylstan scylan;
[8[b]] huru is mæst neod, þæt he asece, hu he yrde mæge fyrme geforðian, ðonne ðæs tima sy.
Æfre he mæig findan on ðam he mæig nyt beon . 7 ða nytte don ðe him fylstan scylan .
Huru is mæst neod þæt he asece hu he yrde mæge fyrme geforðian ðonne ðæs tima sy.
Æfre he mæig findan, on ðam he mæig nyt beon, and ða nytte don ðe him fylstan scylan.
Huru is mæst neod þæt he asece hu he yrde mæge fyrme geforðian ðonne ðæs tima sy.
Immer kann er [der Vogt] entdecken, woran er nützlich sein und solche nützlichen Verrichtungen ausführen kann, welche ihm helfen werden;
namentlich ist zumeist nöthig, dass er erforsche, wie er den Boden durch Bearbeitung fördern könne, wenn der Zeitpunkt dafür ist.
He [the reeve] can always find out how he can be useful and carry out such useful tasks as will help him;
above all it is most necessary that he find out how he can further the land by tillage, when the time for it comes.
He must always discover that in [which] he may be useful, and make use of that which shall assist him.
At the least, it is most desirable that he learns how he may cultivate the land [and] what he should do when it is the right time.
He must always seek out that in which he might be helpful, and take advantage of anything he shall find useful.
In particular, it is most necessary that he learn how to cultivate the earth when it is time.
